chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah or from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed Adam (peace be upon him) said: 'O Lord, You empowered the Satan against me and made him flow from me like blood, so make something for me.' He said: 'O Adam, I have made for you that whoever from your offspring intends an evil deed, it is not recorded against him; if he does it, one evil deed is recorded against him. And whoever from them intends a good deed but does not do it, one good deed is recorded for him; if he does it, ten are recorded for him.'
He said: 'O Lord, increase for me.' He said: 'I have made for you that whoever from them does an evil deed, then seeks forgiveness for it, I forgive him.'
He said: 'O Lord, increase for me.' He said: 'I made repentance for them,' or said: 'I extended repentance for them until the soul reaches this (the throat).'
He said: 'O Lord, that is sufficient for me.'
ai.seo_question: What did Adam ask God for in exchange for Satan's influence over him?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the theological principle of 'al-Hamal bi al-Amal' (accountability by action), distinguishing between mere intention and actual execution, a cornerstone of Shia jurisprudence regarding the recording of deeds. It further emphasizes the expansive nature of divine mercy, noting that repentance remains valid until the 'breath reaches the throat' (al-ghargara), a specific moment of death in Shia tradition, before the seal of finality is set.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Ibn Bukeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> or from Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:

‘Adam<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> (Allowed) the Satan<sup style="font-weight: normal">la</sup> to overcome upon me<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> and flow from me<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> the flowing of the blood, therefore Make something to be for me (as well)’. So He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Said: “O Adam<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>! I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Make it to be for you<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> that the one from your<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> offspring who intends an evil deed, it would not be Written against him, but if he does do it, one evil deed would be Written against him. The one from them who intends a good deed but he does not do it, one good deed would be Written for him, but if he does do it, ten would be Written for him”.

He<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! Increase for me<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>’. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Said: “I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> have Made it to be for you<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> that the one from them who does an evil deed, then seeks Forgiveness for it, I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> would Forgive it for him”.

He<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! Increase for me<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>! He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Said: “I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> have Made the repentance to be for them”, or said: “Extended the repentance for them until the soul reaches this (throat)’.
He<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! It is sufficient for me<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from ibn Bukayr from abu ‘Abd Allah or abu la’ far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Adam said, ‘O Lord, you have made Satan dominate me and made him flow in me like blood, so make something for me also.’ The Lord said, ‘O Adam, for your benefit I have given your offspring the advantage of not writing down against them any sin if they only intend to commit an evil deed. If they actually commit an evil deed only one evil deed is written against them. If anyone of them intends to perform a good deed one good deed is written down for him even if he did not perform it. If, however, he actually performs it ten good deeds are written for him.’

Adam said, ‘O Lord, increase favors upon me.’ The Lord said, ‘I have also assigned for your benefit that if anyone of your offspring commits a sin and then pleads before Me for forgiveness I forgive him.’

Adam said, ‘Lord, grant me more favors.’ The Lord said, ‘I, for their advantage, have made repentance available to them’ or he (the Imam) said that the Lord said, ‘I have extended the time for repentance in their favor up to the time the soul reaches this (throat).’
Adam then said, ‘Lord, this is sufficient for me.’”
